data.exact_reserve_text: Included within the profit is an amount of GBP 26.8 million in respect of releases to reserves on 2012 and prior underwriting years (2013: GBP 10.8 million in respect of reserve releases from 2011 and prior underwriting years, excluding the additional margin discussed above).

prior_year_events.impact_description: Release of reserves on 2012 and prior underwriting years reported as contributing GBP 26.8m to profit (net of reinsurance).

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2014 were GBP 1,170.467m. During 2014 the syndicate reported net releases on prior underwriting years (2012 and prior) amounting to GBP 26.8m, driven by a comparatively benign claims experience. The reported GBP 26.8m figure is stated net of reinsurance; no gross prior-year-only movement was disclosed in the notes, so the quantified movement is the net release.
raw_causal_phrases: benefited from a comparatively benign claims experience
releases to reserves on 2012 and prior underwriting years

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development amount used is the explicitly-stated net figure (GBP 26.8m release) because the report does not present a gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' number separated from current year movements. The opening reserves figure is taken directly from the Balance Sheet (gross claims outstanding at 31 Dec 2013). No gross claims development triangle was found in the extracted pages to permit calculation of a gross prior-year movement.
